_note: Candidate registry for Missouri 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Missouri Secretary of State, Certification of Candidates and Party Emblems, General Election November 3, 2026 (certified August 25, 2026 by Secretary of State Denny Hoskins), linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Missouri Secretary of State, Certification of Candidates and Party Emblems, General Election November 3, 2026 (certified August 25, 2026 by Secretary of State Denny Hoskins) (https://www.sos.mo.gov/CMSImages/ElectionCandidates/2026GeneralElectionCertifiedCandidates.pdf); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
